The camera delivers crisp, high-resolution video and photo quality, so every jump, sprint, and dive is recorded in stunning detail. Lightweight and portable, it slips easily into your kit bag without adding unnecessary bulk. The durable construction is built to withstand the bumps and knocks that come with outdoor adventures. With intuitive controls, switching between modes is quick and effortless, even when you are on the move.
